title: Service Fee Return by Night-Usage Reliance, Residential Electricity Supply Disputes
content:
Billing review standard, Residential Electricity Supply time-of-use disputes.

**Rule.** The night-usage reliance is the agreement's off-peak kWh taken as a share of all the kWh on its energy charge lines. At a reliance of 0.40 or more the plan's full monthly service fee is added to the disputed amount; from 0.20 up to but not including 0.40, half (a share of 0.5) of that fee is added; below 0.20 nothing is added.

**Inputs.** The kWh on all of the agreement's off-peak energy lines, divided by the kWh on all of its energy charge lines (on-peak, off-peak and all-hours alike), whenever billed. The fee is the monthly service fee of the plan in force on the agreement, as the plan pricing schedule states it. An agreement with no kWh on its energy lines adds nothing.

| Night-usage reliance | Added to the disputed amount |
|---|---|
| 0.40 or more | the plan's full monthly service fee |
| 0.20 up to but not including 0.40 | half of that fee |
| below 0.20 | nothing |

**Worked shares (hypothetical agreement, monthly service fee of 9.95 USD).** 2,000 off-peak kWh of 5,000 total kWh is a reliance of 0.40 and adds 9.95 USD; 1,999 of 5,000 is 0.3998 and adds 4.975 USD, carried unrounded into the total; 990 of 5,000 is 0.198 and adds nothing.
